notes.title: Update patch 1.01
notes.content: [p]I fixed some bugs, unclear instructions and an inventory image.[/p][p]The level and XP system will now save the player's progress continuously and not just when the game is auto saved.[/p][p]The weapon menu will now also close with the escape key.[/p][p]When exiting the vehicle, the weapon will be automatically drawn.[/p]

notes.title: Demo patch
notes.content:
Car trunk closing bug is fixed (the player will not get locked on close the trunk).
Player explosives now can hurt the player if he is too close.
Invert Y is now a settings feature.
Better lip sync accuracy.
Some other bugs fixed.
